recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No current core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-25796; any R4/R4B validator override behavior is outside this current-build reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-25796 was a Published, Persuasive CDS technical correction for RiskAssessment.prediction. It reported that ras-2 used `probability is decimal implies (probability as decimal) <= 100`, which fails valid predictions with no probability because an empty FHIRPath result is not a satisfied constraint, and requested an existence-guarded expression.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied to master and R4B. Git history shows R4B commit e1bc1023d533d370b4110537f2328e514f589b6b replacing the broken expression with `probability.exists($this is decimal) implies (probability as decimal) <= 100`; later current-source history in f3776db814632e6cab1020e2299919bb529201da changed the active StructureDefinition to the equivalent `probability.empty() or ((probability is decimal) implies ((probability as decimal) <= 100))` form.
additional_context: RiskAssessment is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/riskassessment/structuredefinition-RiskAssessment.xml is current build input. FHIR-27875 later changed the same probability element by adding Quantity support and ras-3; follow-up history preserved the missing-probability guard, and the combined branch already has a separate FHIR-27875 reconciliation commit. Zulip discussion confirms both the general empty-collection FHIRPath problem and the specific RiskAssessment R4/R4B validator failure; Confluence searches found no conflicting minutes.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active ras-2 expression already lets RiskAssessment.prediction omit probability while still enforcing decimal probabilities to be <= 100. Old broken ras-2 expressions found by search are in tools/history release snapshots for earlier published versions, not authoritative current-build source.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied RiskAssessment probability issue changed the same element by adding Quantity handling and ras-3, but it is already represented separately on the combined branch.
Bundle.fullUrl constraint issue from the same FHIRPath empty-collection discussion pattern; it concerns a different artifact and was not part of this RiskAssessment decision.
